typography.body: Gilroy role with Urbanist variable fallback until licensed files arrive
typography.display: Gilroy role with Urbanist variable fallback until licensed files arrive
typography.editorial: Cirka role with Libre Bodoni variable fallback until licensed files arrive

must: Use the local components/neopop compatibility layer
Keep Taskify branding and affirmative momentum semantics
Preserve 3px 45-degree plunk geometry and 120ms press motion
Support keyboard focus, reduced motion, desktop and mobile
avoid: Do not add Astryx dependencies or imports
Do not hotlink CRED fonts or copy CRED brand artwork

decisions.decision: Replace Astryx with a Taskify-owned NeoPOP compatibility layer pinned to upstream commit 1f4b3d2.
decisions.reason: Match the selected visual system while staying compatible with React 19 and Next.js 16.

decisions.decision: Use an affirmative momentum rail: yellow next move, blue active work, green progress, pink celebration.
decisions.reason: Make NeoPOP product-specific to Taskify instead of copying CRED branding.

decisions.decision: Use Urbanist for Gilroy roles and Libre Bodoni for Cirka roles until licensed local font files are supplied.
decisions.reason: Match the migration typography contract closely without redistributing commercial font binaries in a public repository.
